steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You know, it's real hard getting an audience with you these days.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: ...Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am truly sorry I was unable to attend the Matriarch's funeral.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Madam Sciurus, I am deeply saddened by what has befallen the Browntail clan. Please let me know if there is anything Clan Silverash can do to help.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Thanks, Enciodes.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But that's not what I came here to discuss.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your visit this time, Madam Sciurus, must be to give me a chance to earn your trust.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph... My sister once told me that you're least trustworthy when you lower your head like this.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I wonder about your opinion of me, then.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You don't have to beat around the bush. I don't like it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: My sister used to scold me for being impulsive, and for not always thinking things through before I speak or act.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I wanted to prove to her that I didn't need to hide under her wing, that I could do something for Clan Browntail.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But now, as new matriarch of the clan, there is no one left for me to prove anything to.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand how you feel. I... also have two younger sisters.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And you think they're both smarter than me, huh? Both Ensia, and the Saintess...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You think too little of yourself, Madam Sciurus.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, I do think they share your persistence and determination.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Is Ensia okay? I heard... she was in an accident.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thank you for your concern. She is safe and sound, and has already returned home.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You always keep that calm and composed demeanor.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What I want to know is... these attacks on Kjerag, including what happened to my sister... Did you know about them ahead of time?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So this is the real reason you decided to visit me today.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Enciodes, my sister had been helping you this entire time, isn't that right?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I wasn't totally in the dark about it, but it wasn't until her passing that I learned...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Your plans—for Victoria, Rhine Lab, and what Monch has been investigating... There's too much I don't know anything about.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Don't try to deny it. Don't lie to me, Enciodes. You have to know the truth behind her murder.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you truly believe I had a hand in the Matriarch's death—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No... That's not what I mean.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I don't know what Ratatos was plotting with you, but I know for sure... that whatever it was, it was to protect Kjerag.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So... I will follow in her footsteps... Whatever Clan Browntail's affairs may be, I will take responsibility for them.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Which is why... I need you to tell me exactly what happened to her—

steps.name: Silverash Clan Guard
steps.text: My apologies, Sir Enciodes, but they were determined to break in no matter what—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To what do I owe the honor, for you all to barge into my home like this?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, why did Karlan Trade transfer all its shares in the Kjerag-Kazimierz joint mining operation to Victoria without authorization?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Where did this news come from?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: It is an observable fact—the mines have completely been taken over by the Victorians.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Great Elder Adso believes that such actions by Karlan Trade constitute illegal collusion with a foreign power, and as such, the Vine-Bead Court has no choice but to exercise its authority to intervene.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: We require that you report to the Vine-Bead Court immediately to explain yourself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I understand this correctly, the Vine-Bead Court means to formally interrogate Clan Silverash?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: The people of Kjerag are uneasy enough as it is. The last thing we want is to see this conflict escalate further.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: However, Sir Enciodes, as the head of the clan, if you still believe you bear responsibility for Kjerag, please go to the Vine-Bead Court with us to discuss the next steps.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Very well. I have no reason to refuse.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, if I am to explain the situation, I will need some time to prepare the relevant documents. Please allow me that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Furthermore, I still have some things to discuss with Madam Sciurus, so I would like to ask for your patience.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Of course, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Madam Sciurus, thank you for taking the time to look after Ensia. I would like to formally invite you to be a guest of Clan Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I would also like to thank you for your concern in person, while Ensia is present as well.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Wha...?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It would have been more courteous to have sent the invitation to you in a formal capacity.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But given the hasty nature of this matter, the best I can do is to throw something together by hand. I do hope you'll forgive me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We look forward to you gracing us with your presence.
Before his 'invitee' can respond, Enciodes picks up a pen and paper from the table, scribbles down a few lines, then hands the 'invitation' over.
Sciurus takes it. There is only an address on the piece of paper, hardly an invitation at all.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Thank you for the invitation.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll be there on time.

a.text: To Mr. Edelweiss of Karlan Trade:
I hope this letter finds you well.
At the time you are read this, I am yet to receive sitrep authorization from Rhine Lab, so please take note—
This letter does not, in any capacity, serve as an agreement or treaty between Rhine Lab and Karlan Trade. Rather, it only represents my personal analysis of the recent phenomena in Kjerag.
My specimen comes from the sound waves collected by the observation station at 3:19 AM on December 7, 1101.
I can say for certain that at that time, an unidentified object fell from the sky onto Mount Karlan.
Though the chain of evidence definitively linking the phenomena is still missing, a Catastrophe did in fact occur 32 hours later.
I do not intend to establish a causal link between these two things. If this crash is a singular event in history, then so too is the Catastrophe.
What I AM preparing to do is to confirm whether or not there is an empirical connection between these two events.
Additionally, do forgive my frankness, but if the hypothesis that these two events are linked does bear out, the outcome for Kjerag is not optimistic—
Whatever factor that has protected Kjerag from Catastrophes over the millennia may no longer be effective, or at least, be in an unusable state.
I would, of course, love to write this off as mere conjecture. But nevertheless, I also hope that Karlan Trade will be adequately mindful of the potential risks moving forward.
Carolin, an insider with more detailed information, has likely made similar inferences, but I am in the dark as to what her objectives are at this moment.
I will strive to complete this research while maintaining an objective and rational perspective, and would greatly appreciate Karlan Trade's support in my efforts.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: I was just looking for you, Director.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Take this letter over to Enciodes. Classify it top secret.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir. Right away.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Any other news?

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Yes—the observation post previously dispatched to the mining site has sent back a sighting report.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: A convoy bearing Victorian markings is approaching the outskirts of the mine, but the specific origins are unknown.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Matterhorn led his clansmen there ahead of time. He said that he would try to stall for as much time as possible and await your judgment.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The Victorians would've come sooner or later. Looks like we won't have to wait any longer.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Prepare vehicles as soon as possible. Matterhorn may not be able to hold them off for long.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Tell him to let the other party make the first move, and prioritize observation. I will arrive shortly.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: ...I'm warning you, don't get in our way, if you know what's good for you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I am simply following orders. The area ahead is a restricted warehouse, and nobody is allowed to enter without Karlan Trade's permission.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Has no one informed you that House Caster has acquired all of Kazimierz's rights to this site?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: To the best of my knowledge, the handover process is still underway. We were only notified by Kazimierz yesterday.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Which is why we have to inspect all the assets in advance. If you have an complaints, you can take them up with Her Grace the Duke.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Now, listen to your betters and open the warehouse door post-haste.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Finally, someone worth talking to.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Mr. Gnosis Edelweiss of Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It seems the introduction I've prepared will be going to waste, good sir.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Of course. Naturally, you also understand who I'm representing here.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Due to your mismanagement and the resultant substantial financial losses, Her Grace the Duke has decided to dismiss some key employees of Karlan Trade employed at this site, including the former executive manager.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: To this, I have no objection. I will cooperate fully during this handover process.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Excellent. Now then, Mr. Edelweiss, please open the warehouse door.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...However, on this point alone, I cannot comply.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What Matterhorn said is true. There indeed are regulations pertaining to this confidential warehouse. I humbly ask for yours and Her Grace's understanding.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Based on the information I have, the security clearance level on this warehouse was raised just recently.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: What do you say to this, Mr. Edelweiss?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Allow me to explain.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This warehouse is mainly used to store various kinds of industrial waste, but recently, the purification system and negative pressure ventilation system both malfunctioned.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We temporarily raised the security clearance level and strictly restricted access in the interim before professionals can handle the situation.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I fully understand Her Grace's concern about the assets acquired, but for your safety, could I ask that this inspection be postponed?

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I accept the risks at hand. Just open the door.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: All else aside, this is Kjerag's mine.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Should pollutants leak, or any other dangerous situation arises, Kjerag does not rule out the right to intervene through administrative measures.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Before you offer to take responsibility, I suggest you contact Her Grace the Duke once more.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Good to see you again, Mr. Matterhorn.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Pardon me, Father. I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to wait at reception for now. I currently have business with our diplomatic guest.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Mr. Edelweiss, I was expressly invited here by the Victorians.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Since when is the Vine-Bead Court so concerned with temporal affairs?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Today, both the clan leadership and the general public are dissatisfied with the way Karlan Trade has been engaging with Victoria.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: The Great Elder has summoned Sir Enciodes to an inquiry into the matter; perhaps, you will also need to report to the Vine-Bead Court soon.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why, then, would a cleric feel a need to accept an invitation to come here before that?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: I wish to ensure a smooth handover process, and hope that Karlan Trade is willing to cooperate to the fullest extent.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: Please open the warehouse door, Mr. Edelweiss.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Given that power has been restored by the three clans, perhaps the Vine-Bead Court would be more representative of Kjerag's 'administrative measures'?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Matterhorn, open the door.
The door slowly opens, and the Victorian ambassador is caught unaware by the dust that diffuses from within. He squints and fans the air in front of him with his hand.
There is neither the smell of industrial waste nor the texture of Originium dust. The ambassador's eyes gradually adjust to the vast, unobstructed warehouse, within which is—

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: ...Nothing but scrap metal?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As I stated, there is nothing here but industrial waste.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Please leave as soon as you've finished your inspection. Staying here for an extended period of time would be detrimental to your health.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Everyone, stay put. I'm conducting the inspection myself.

As soon as he enters the warehouse, he feels the vast space around him dilating in all directions, the steel frames stretching straight to the ceiling surrounded by scrap metal of all shapes and sizes.
There's no way such a large warehouse was set up just to store these things. It's far too pretentious.
He approaches the bottom of one of the shelves and reaches out to rummage through it with no particular aim in mind. The clanging of metal echoes through the warehouse.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: (Hushed voice) Wait, this is...

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: (Hushed voice) It's still half-intact, and I can still make out the insignia of Silverash's private army, the 'Tschäggättä'. Were these originally weapons and gear not improperly disposed of after being thrown in the shredder...?
An idea bubbles up, and he keeps looking elsewhere. Though Karlan Trade has been quite meticulous, a few clues are bound to leak through. Of this, he is certain.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: (Hushed voice) Replicas of Victoria's newest equipment, as well as large-caliber naval gun parts...

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: (Hushed voice) All failures, unable to break through the technical barrier...
The army designations. The insignias. Many other terms in the Kjeragi language. He quietly memorizes them all.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Sir! Are you done yet?

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: ...Yes, I am.
The ambassador returns to the group.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I've more or less seen what I needed to see, Mr. Edelweiss.

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: I will summarize the entire situation and faithfully report it to the Duke.

steps.name: Victorian Guard
steps.text: Sir, the internal railway in the mining site has just been cleared, and you haven't had time to inspect it yet.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Does Victoria also need to use that internal railway?

steps.name: Victorian Ambassador
steps.text: Yes, we've contacted a number of suppliers for quotes. Using the internal railway can significantly reduce transportation costs.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Father, is the Vine-Bead Court aware of this? If you are so keen to get involved in diplomatic affairs, Karlan Trade hopes that you will also be willing to verify any business entities that wish to join.
Gnosis's concern interrupts the thoughts of the Vine-Bead Court envoy, who then looks away from the railway.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: ...That would require the Great Elder's input.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: By Kjeragandr, I ask that the Vine-Bead Court not make things difficult for Enciodes. I will remain at Karlan Trade's headquarters, awaiting your summons.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Envoy
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.
